title: Moneta Business Banking
summary: A business banking concept for startups and scale-ups, where financial trust meets digital simplicity.

heroMedia.alt: Upload: Moneta out-of-home posters in a station (16:9)

cardMedia.alt: Upload: Moneta cover for the project card (4:5)

challenge: Modern businesses have outgrown traditional banking. Disconnected financial tools, manual workflows and limited visibility make it harder for teams to manage money and scale with confidence. A bank for these companies has to feel as trustworthy as an institution and as simple as the software they already use.
approach: We built the brand on three principles: clarity, stability and growth. A refined navy and emerald palette carries the trust; Söhne and Inter typography, modular layouts and subtle data visualisations carry the simplicity.
solution: A structured, scalable design system that runs through the whole Moneta experience — business dashboards, corporate cards, cash-flow analytics and payment interfaces, as well as landing pages, marketing assets and physical brand applications.
results: A financial identity that feels modern, confident and structured: built for businesses moving forward. Moneta is a self-initiated concept by Rukuru Studio.

media.alt: Upload: Moneta logo and pattern overview (16:9)

sections.text: Business banking hasn't kept up with modern companies.

sections.heading: Trust, set in type
sections.body: Söhne gives Moneta its confident voice in headlines; Inter keeps numbers and interfaces precise. Together with the navy and emerald palette, they make money feel calm and under control.
